ABOUT.TITLE: From physical spaces to digital solutions
DESCRIPTION: Two years ago, my interest in programming and software development was born. At that moment, while I was in the degree phase of Architecture, I realized that my true passion was to be a developer.

I began my learning self-taught, studying HTML and CSS with teachers like Midudev and taking advantage of Platzi Days. Then, I acquired courses in Modern JavaScript, React, Next.js and Node.js from teacher Fernando Herrera. At the same time, I researched topics such as rendering strategies, databases, software architecture, best practices and more.
Currently, I work as a freelance developer using Astro and focusing on the performance of my projects. As a future goal, I hope to continue improving and learning more every day.
